skill.summary: NIH funding trend analysis to identify high-priority research areas

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of grant-funding-scout skill (v1.0.0, demonstration version using mock data)
- Analyzes NIH funding trends to identify high-priority research areas
- Provides analysis of top-funded institutions, emerging topics, and funding trends by research area and time window
- Outputs results in JSON, CSV, or text formats
- Includes detailed risk assessment and security checklist
- For educational/demo use only—future production versions intended to integrate with real funding databases
